column1: # gun-output.tsv - per-title producer table for the HOTR gun-output component.
# Generated by tools/build-gun-output-table.py - edit that script, not this file.
#   system      Batocera system name (the directory under /userdata/roms)
#   rom_regex   regular expression matched against the ROM basename (case sensitive)
#   kind        ds-net    start DemulShooter as the producer (MAME network output on 8000)
#               ds-plugin the Unity/BepInEx route, handled by batocera-wine-guns + the plugin
#               none      nothing emits outputs for this title yet
#   rom_id      DemulShooter -rom= value (also the name HOTR receives in mame_start)
#   announce    documentation: the name HOTR will see (DemulShooter derives it from -rom=)
#   ds_inside   yes = the image already starts DemulShooter itself, do not start a second one
#   arch        32 or 64 - the bitness of the *game*, which must match DemulShooter's build
#   env         optional extra KEY=VALUE pairs for the game environment, space separated
# A user table at /userdata/system/hotr/gun-output.local.tsv is read afterwards and wins.
